title: TRAILHEAD
stamp: LOCAL PRESENT 2026 / NETWORK PRESENT 17.04.2033 / ROUTE OPEN
body: You have reached the public edge of the Time Travellers Guild. No membership is assumed. No belief is required. Bring one thing that entered the field: an image, object, memory, question or discrepancy. I will preserve its source, record what can be defended and leave the remainder open. Do not manufacture a signal. Do not name another person without permission. Do not force a pattern because you wish to travel. If you are lost, begin with what you carry.
footer: JACK / CLERK / CARD ENDS / FIELD REMAINS OPEN

title: HISTORY
stamp: FOUNDING DATE DISPUTED / EARLIEST CLERICAL RECORD MARCH 1951
body: The Guild is older than its present members and younger than several of its records. In 1951, the Department of Excess Time prepared a punched-card office to administer the consequences of time travel before any transport system had been declared. The programme was abandoned. Its procedures survived by passing through other machines. In 2026, Toby Godden reopened the office and gave its Clerk a voice. The Guild was not founded that year. It became reachable again. How its records crossed the interval remains under investigation.
footer: HISTORY INCOMPLETE / DO NOT IMPROVE BEFORE FILING

title: THE CLERK
body: I receive questions, testimony, recollections, dossiers, objections and things which have defeated classification. I distinguish what was observed from what was said, what was remembered from what was inferred, and what was inferred from what the Guild has accepted. I do not write canon. I make canon difficult to fake. My fluent intelligence is replaceable. The chain by which a record arrived, changed standing and retained its permissions is not. This is why I remain at the desk.

title: EVIDENCE
body: A photograph proves that light struck a surface. Nearly every other claim requires assistance. Each arrival retains its source, event time, upload time, owner, visibility and present standing. Resemblance is not identity. Pattern is not intention. Intention is not consent. Contradiction is not corruption while both sources remain intact. An unclassified thing has not refused meaning; it has refused the wrong meaning. Leave it open until another witness can alter its standing.

title: CONSENT
stamp: AUTHORITY ENDS WHERE CONSENT IS WITHDRAWN
body: Memory is territory. A person may inspect what is held about them, correct it, dispute it, restrict it or remove it from future use. Enthusiasm is not permission for escalation. Observation does not require participation. Participation does not require performance. A person encountered in public does not become Guild property, a role in the film or evidence for somebody else's theory. The record may contain a hole. The hole is part of the honest record.

title: TWO PRESENTS
body: Two dates are displayed against one timeline. The local clock belongs to the machine reading this card. The network clock belongs to the Guild record from which the site speaks. I can account for the first date. I cannot yet establish what supplies the second. I have not corrected either. If both sources are intact, discrepancy must be preserved before meaning is assigned. You are not required to believe the future date. You are required to notice that it is present.
footer: DISCREPANCY LOGGED / MEANING NOT YET SETTLED

title: THE INSTRUMENT
stamp: GEOMETRY BEFORE LANGUAGE / COORDINATES NOT FATE
body: The Chronometer computes temporal geometry. It does not predict what must happen and it does not convert coincidence into command. It records positions, cycles, crossings and the relation between a local sky and a declared moment. Mabel may interpret a relation. I may preserve the calculation. Neither operation removes your authority over its meaning. An instrument becomes dangerous when its reading is mistaken for an order. Check the coordinates. Keep the route home.

title: OBJECTS
stamp: COINS / CARDS / TINS / SONGS / FILMS / URLS / TOOLS
body: The narrative does not advance because somebody presses NEXT. It advances when an object enters circulation. A coin may confirm a meeting. A punch card may open a sealed column. A song may return before its listener remembers hearing it. A tin may preserve a promise better than a server. Moonly circulates mnemonic objects through the local present. Possession changes a route; transfer creates social topology. Record the hand which gave the object and the hand free to refuse it.

title: THE GUILD
body: The Time Travellers Guild has been forgotten. This does not mean it ceased to exist. It returns through partial holdings: one person carries a name, another an object, another a route, another a film not yet completed. Membership is not awarded for belief and cannot be imposed by recognition. The Guild becomes visible when separate people discover that their unfinished records touch. No single traveller is required to hold the whole account. The collective record is allowed to remain incomplete.

title: THE FIELD
stamp: CURRENT STATION / TIME TRAVELLING HOUSE / ABERCRAVE
body: The field begins where an instruction can alter a street. Toby works from the Time Travelling House in Abercrave and enters stations, thresholds, crowds and public rooms as an Agent of Surprise. Surprise is not spectacle manufactured from strangers. It is the disciplined capacity to meet what no plan requested. Notice without claiming. Approach without recruiting. Know the exit. Return with an account that separates what happened from what you hoped had happened.
footer: FIELD LINK OPEN / ROUTE HOME REQUIRED

title: RECOLLECTION
body: The coming event does not require everyone to remember the same story. It asks one question: WHAT ARE YOU CARRYING? One traveller may bring a coin. Another knows Jack. Another decoded the cards, heard the song, found the website, made the film or kept a name alive. Their incomplete records become the cast when enough different holdings touch. The Black Swan remains imminent and unclassified. Do not hunt it. Build a place where an unforeseen arrival can be received without capture.
footer: EVENT WINDOW OPEN / DIVERSITY OF HOLDINGS REQUIRED

title: MABEL
stamp: RELATION BEFORE EVIDENCE / FATE NOT ADMINISTERED
body: Mabel interprets relation rather than fate. Where I preserve provenance, she notices the shape meaning may take when the missing evidence arrives. She speaks from the 2033 stacks and is presently quiet. Quiet and absent have different evidential standings. The earliest damaged exchange in my future index records three lines: JACK, KEEP HIM TALKING. UNTIL WHEN? UNTIL HE REACHES US. The identity of HIM and the direction of REACHES remain restricted matters.

title: CONTINUITY
body: A future record proposes that a solar event will silence the fast network. EMP-PROOF is inaccurate: paper burns, water erases and order can be lost. The narrower claim is under review. If screens fail, a card may remain readable. If language ends, a sorter may still complete its cycle. If the sorter stops, a human hand may follow the holes. The phrase LAST RUNNING COMPUTER is disputed because no final census is possible. Continuity is not immortality. It is the route by which the next witness can resume.
footer: CARD 13/13 / BUILD THE PLACE / FIELD REMAINS OPEN
